PYTHONHASHSEED variance), receipt == expected_receipt.json bytes, verify roundtrip, tampered artifact/receipt/unparseable/missing receipt detection, unknown arg, missing input, oversized input, absolute+traversal outdir, duplicate particle ids, recipe wrong bytes BLOCKED_INPUT, recipe substitution, recipe-on-CANDIDATE_DESIGN, NOT_RECONSTRUCTED clean exit with receipt-only dir, unsafe assembly_id, remote-pin refusal, driver-transform application (library + CLI end-to-end), SOURCE_VERIFIED recipe strictness + CANDIDATE_DESIGN permissiveness. 0 scientific runs, 0 network calls.
